decision_log_integration.reason: The source names UTC-offset-minute fields but does not define sign; HT-25 requires a dated UTC construction.
decision_log_integration.reviewed_treatment: Binding provisional offset_minutes = local - UTC; UTC = local timestamp - offset; null/non-finite offset is UNRESOLVED_UTC_DATE.
decision_log_integration.tests: Positive, negative, and zero offsets; departure and arrival; arrival-day crossing; midnight date shift; expanded timestamp precedence; null/non-finite unresolved; HT-25 and every UTC/both-clock interface test.
decision_log_integration.rollback: On authoritative opposite-sign evidence, change subtraction to addition, regenerate affected fixtures/manifest, compare complete results, and rerun the named tests.
